get_formats: get a list of OutputFormat instances from a format string and BaseCompressor for model export
check_compatibility: check whether a list of export formats is compatible with a given quantization scheme
OutputFormat_register: register a new OutputFormat subclass under one or more format names for model export
OutputFormat_get_support_matrix: get a formatted string showing which quantization schemes each export format supports
GGUFFormat_gguf_args_check: validate and reset quantization arguments to match a target GGUF export format configuration
